d: Gen Z is saving money. But it is also borrowing more than ever. In India, young borrowers are taking a growing share of digital loans. Credit cards, EMIs and buy-now-pay-later schemes have made borrowing just a few taps away. But with rent, groceries and everyday expenses eating into salaries, is debt becoming a way to survive the month? And when several small EMIs start adding up, how easily can they turn into a debt trap? Palki Sharma breaks down the growing debt dilemma facing Gen Z.
